title: geoffroea decorticans
intro: Geoffroea decorticans, commonly known as the Marula or Korup Tree, is a deciduous tree native to tropical Africa, characterized by its broad leaves and showy flowers. The bark, roots, and leaves of Geoffroea decorticans have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geoffroea decorticans include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable treatment for conditions like fever, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
